ai.title: Script
ai.hint: Save your key and press Refresh list to see the models you can use.
review.title: Review the script
review.hint: Edit the text and the keywords; the first sentence of scene 1 is the hook. Then press “Create video”.
preview.label: Preview
progress.label: Progress of the current video
queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: No videos yet. Type a topic and press “Create video”.
settings.title: Settings
settings.keys_hint: Keys are stored only on this computer and sent only to the service they belong to.
settings.quit_text: The app will close. A video in progress goes back to the queue.
settings.quit_done: Baitd has closed. You can close this tab now.
err.network: Could not reach Baitd → Check that the app is still open and reload the page
err.topic: The topic is missing → Type a topic
err.topics: There are no topics → Type one topic per line
err.scene: A scene is empty or has no keywords → Complete it or write the script again
err.name: The name is missing → Type a name for the profile
err.lang: The language code is missing → Type one, for example pt
tabs.label: Section
clip.drop: Drop a file or paste a link
clip.count_help: How many clips to make from the video. Baitd picks the best moments, up to that number.
clip.len_help: Each clip runs between the minimum and the maximum, in seconds. Baitd cuts at sentence ends within that range.
trans.title: Transcription
framing.title: Framing
framing.hint: Face follows whoever speaks; full shows the whole frame over a blurred background.
extras.title: Extras
extras.music_hint: Uses the music chosen in Create short.
clip.rights: If you use other channels' videos, respect their rights and each platform's rules.
clip.analyzing: Finding moments… The list will appear here when it is done.
clip.review_hint: Tick the ones you want, adjust start and end, then press “Export selected”.
clip.discard_confirm: The analysis of “{title}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
clip.why_none: No clip is ticked → Tick at least one to export
clip.why_many: More than 20 clips are ticked → Untick some, 20 is the most per export
clip.keep_note: Exporting deletes the original video and the candidates you did not export.
clip.switch_confirm: The review you have open has edits you have not exported → Open the other one and lose them, or cancel to keep working
clip.why_bad: A ticked clip has an invalid start or end → Fix it or untick it
moment.title: Title
moment.err_time: Invalid time → Use mm:ss, for example 1:05
moment.err_len: The clip must last between 10 and 180 s → Adjust the start or the end
moment.err_range: The clip goes past the video, which lasts {d} → Adjust the start or the end
settings.update_confirm: Baitd will close, install version {v} and open again. A video in progress goes back to the queue.
settings.update_installing: Installing the update… Baitd will reopen on its own.
settings.keep_hint: Otherwise the downloaded or uploaded video is deleted once the clips are done.
settings.yt_hint: Use it when YouTube asks you to confirm you're not a bot. On Windows, Chrome and Edge don't let other apps read their session: pick Firefox or a cookies.txt file.
settings.yt_file_hint: Open youtube.com signed in, export the cookies with the «Get cookies.txt LOCALLY» extension and paste the file's path here. A file is used instead of the browser. Cookies never leave your computer.
settings.ytdlp_hint: If links stop working, update it. The new version is used after restarting Baitd.
settings.ytdlp_done: yt-dlp {version} installed → Restart Baitd to use it
err.clip_source: The video is missing → Paste a link or upload a file
err.clip_url: That link is not valid → Paste an http or https link
err.clip_count: Invalid number of clips → Choose between 1 and 20
err.clip_len: Invalid length → Use 10 to 180 s, with the minimum not above the maximum
err.upload: The upload failed → Upload the file again
err.upload_type: That file type can't be uploaded → Use MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3 or WAV
err.analysis_gone: That analysis no longer exists → Find moments again
